historical_record.description: The Mayor approved a schedule dedicating six new playgrounds of the 1947 recreation bond program, with Presidio Heights Playground set for the evening of June 6.

Under the 1947 recreation bond program the Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, to lay out the whole of Presidio Heights Playground on the south side of Clay Street between Walnut and Laurel, field house included.
The Recreation Commission awarded the contract for improvements to Presidio Heights Playground and its field house to H. L. Petersen Construction Company at $37,774.
